title: Classic Algerian Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew originating from the Tagine, a clay pot with a conical lid. This recipe is rich, aromatic, and comforting.

ingredients.name: algerian
ingredients.notes: Use Algerian spice mix as the base for the stew's flavor

ingredients.name: yellowed
ingredients.notes: This likely refers to saffron, a key ingredient in traditional tagines

ingredients.name: starch
ingredients.notes: Use semolina or couscous for a traditional tagine texture

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: A traditional clay pot with a conical lid for slow-cooking the stew

instructions: Rinse the pot and dry it thoroughly.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the Algerian spice mix and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the starch (semolina or couscous) and stir to coat with the spice mix.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine with its conical lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30-40 minutes or until the starch is cooked through and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
